_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)

The Current campaign-balance cell has '1,066.44' struck out and '0.00' written below it — the struck figure is NOT transcribed as the value. Address redacted by the county. Last and Cumulative cells print the Excel zero-dash. It had been left blank by the 2026-08-01 transcription; the date line is NOT empty on this sheet. Money cells unchanged.

contributions.detail: exact - 1 row (Kacey Bates, self, 1,066.44) = the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS' box AND the cover's current-report figure. The cover's cumulative column is blank on this filing (a dash), so the current column is the gate; there is only one reporting period in play and no period-vs-cumulative question arises.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: Each 2026 schedule prints its total as a labelled last row inside the grid. p2 ends in 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS  $1,066.44' and the single row is 1,066.44 - exact, and equal to the cover. p3 ends in 'TOTAL EXPENSES  $1,066.44' and the single row is 1,066.44 - exact, and equal to the cover. The candidate self-funded the Sheriff filing fee exactly and the cover's balance is 0. No specimen rows exist on the 2026 form.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: THIS IS THE TRUE COUNTY REDACTION CASE and it looks nothing like the 2022 white-out: on p2 the donor row's ADDRESS cell is covered by a SOLID BLACK BAR spanning the whole column width, applied over the scan (the file name's '_Redacted' suffix is literal here). donor_city/donor_state are therefore blank BECAUSE THE COUNTY REDACTED THEM, not because the filer left them empty - a different fact, and the distinction is recorded on the row itself. Everything else on both pages is intact. FILER'S OWN CORRECTION ON THE EXPENSE ROW: the 'Person or Organization' cell contains an original entry struck out with heavy blue scribble and 'Summit County' written above it in the row above; a second struck blue scribble precedes it. The struck original was escalated to a 1600 dpi tight crop and remains ILLEGIBLE (two ink layers over each other) - it is recorded as illegible rather than guessed, and the surviving correction governs (clerk-correction precedent), so vendor_raw is 'Summit County' with 'Filing fee' in the Purpose column. Note that the correction moves the payee OUT of the purpose column - the same payee/purpose confusion seen on the Franchek 2022 pair, here caught and fixed by the filer. DATES: this filer writes a cursive 6 that closes like a lowercase 'e' (the same loop appears in '1,066.44'), so the year on both rows resolves to 26. The contribution row reads 01-07-26 and the expense row 01-12-26 - two different days, escalated at 1600 and 2000 dpi; the contribution row's day glyph is the weaker of the two and is carried at date=low. Scan quality is poor overall (index text_quality 'low': a blue stamp bleeds through the header and the page is faintly double-imaged) and that, plus the redaction bar, is what took seven escalations. GEOMETRY: p3 is MEASURED (band 5, the dated row; the 'Summit County' correction sits in band 4 immediately above it). p2 is DECLARED because the black redaction bar spans the address column and merges the header and data bands into one 3.84-high block for rowbands; the declared frame (y0 24.20, pitch 1.93) is taken from the page's own regular rules below the block (1.93-1.95 throughout) and band 2 was crop-verified to frame the donor row.
